startx-clarify-health-solutions:lever:63.descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for the optimists, the changemakers, the status quo smashers, and those who reject the very idea of the impossible. At Clarify, we firmly believe that healthcare can (and should) perform better. Our AI-driven healthcare analytics solutions help some of the biggest entities in healthcare pinpoint new ways to do so, starting with their margins and their missions. We’re looking for talented individuals to join us in blueprinting the next evolution of healthcare.

Clarify is seeking a motivated and experienced Physician Liaison to engage directly with healthcare providers and practices to support Clarify’s outcomes-based partnerships. In this role, you will guide providers/practices through sustained behavior change, including optimizing utilization of in-network, high-quality, and efficient care delivery. You will combine data-driven insights and structured change management approaches to build provider commitment and deliver measurable partnership outcomes. 
 
Does this sound like you? 
  • You have experience working directly with a variety of providers and physicians (e.g., physician liaison, provider relations, or pharmaceutical sales) 
  • You understand that changing practice patterns requires more than sharing data; it requires diagnosing readiness, building trust, and meeting people where they are 
  • You have a passion for value-based care and for using technology-enabled insights to deliver higher-value, more efficient care 
  • You think in terms of “what motivates this person” and naturally tailor your approach to different audiences 
  • You value working with hardworking, curious, and supportive teammates 
  • You embrace change as an opportunity to learn 
  • You believe diversity of thought improves our outcomes 
  • You take great care in the details 

As a Physician Liaison, you will serve as a trusted advisor to healthcare providers and practices, guiding them through a structured change journey to optimize utilization of in-network, high-quality care delivery. You’ll leverage Clarify’s platform and engagement playbooks to diagnose each provider or practice’s readiness for change. 

This role goes beyond traditional provider relations. You will function as a change agent, combining consultative relationship skills with a systematic, data-informed approach to influence providers/practices to achieve sustained behavior change. 

 

What you’ll do 

Provider Partnership & Relationship Management 

  • Build and maintain trusted, collaborative relationships with assigned providers (physicians, practice administrators, and staff) 

  • Conduct regular interactions (both virtual and in-person) to review performance, co-develop improvement plans, and address barriers to change 

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and advocate for assigned providers, representing their needs and perspectives internally 

Education & Enablement 

  • Engage with practice administration, staff, and providers to support workflow improvement, education, and awareness on value-based care program requirements, quality measures, and performance incentives 

  • Collaborate with internal teams to resolve barriers that may inhibit provider adoption 

Performance Analysis & Insights 

  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives tailored to each provider and/or practice  

  • Monitor progress on initiatives, track leading indicators of behavior change, and adjust strategies based on results 

Documentation & Engagement Tracking 

  • Maintain detailed records of interactions, change stage assessments, and engagement activities in CRM (Salesforce) 

  • Provide regular reporting on territory performance, behavior change trends, and forecasted impact 

 
  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business, or related field 

    • 2–4 years of healthcare experience in one or more of the following areas: 

    • Provider engagement, network relations, or account management 

    • Value-based care program operations or implementation 

    • Healthcare consulting or practice transformation 

    • Proven ability to establish trust and credibility through partnership-oriented, non-transactional engagement 

    • Proficiency in interpreting healthcare utilization data, cost trends, referral patterns, and quality metrics; comfortable working with analytics platforms and Excel 

    • Excellent verbal and written communication with the ability to translate complex data into compelling, provider-specific narratives; comfortable presenting to both clinical and administrative audiences 

    • Ability to independently manage a territory, prioritize activities, and drive results with minimal supervision 

    • Proficient with CRM systems, analytics platforms, and structured engagement tools  

    • Willingness to leverage AI-powered tools and insights to enhance engagement preparation, analysis, and strategy development 

    • Consultative mindset with genuine desire to help providers succeed 

    • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to read interpersonal dynamics, adapting your approach in real time 

    • Strong work ethic and accountability for territory performance and behavior change outcomes 

    • Team player who shares knowledge, effective tactics, and best practices with colleagues 

    Nice-to-have: 

    • Master’s degree (MHA, MBA, MPH, MSN) 

    • Practice operations experience 

    • Exposure to change management methodologies or behavioral science concepts 

    • Experience with ACO operations, Medicare Shared Savings Program, or commercial value-based care contracts 

    • Physician Liaisons will ideally be located within the Houston, TX area or assigned territory/region, as in-person visits are an imperative component of our work.  Will consider candidates outside of the region who are willing to travel. 

  • Competitive compensation (base, bonus, + equity)
  • Quality health insurance
  • Traditional 401K plan
  • Vision, dental, disability, and life insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts and Commuter Benefits
  • Generous PTO
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend
  • Remote friendly
  • A collaborative workplace, which will challenge you and celebrate your work
  • A chance to learn with and from interesting and enthusiastic colleagues

At Clarify, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles!

startx-swarm-aero:ashbyhq:ca0dd343-6bb1-.descriptionHtml:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

The Role

We're looking for a Head of Avionics who has genuinely built complex avionics systems, not managed programs or reviewed other people's work, but gotten their hands into the architecture, made hard tradeoffs, and shipped something real. You'll own the avionics stack end-to-end: hardware architecture, embedded systems, sensing, networking, autonomy integration, and the test infrastructure to verify all of it. You'll be a technical leader and a hands-on contributor, setting the direction while staying deep enough to know when something is wrong.

This is a zero-to-one role. If you're looking for a well-defined org with established processes, this isn't it. If you want to define the architecture of the most capable autonomous aircraft system ever built, keep reading.

What You'll Own

  • Architect the full avionics stack for large uncrewed aircraft, from hardware selection through system integration

  • Design and build embedded systems across real-time and non-real-time environments, both airborne and ground-side

  • Drive development of autonomy, novel sensing, and networking capabilities that enable swarm-scale operations

  • Build and own the hardware and software-in-the-loop test infrastructure for avionics validation

  • Be the technical authority on avionics across the company, setting standards, catching problems early, and making calls

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in embedded systems, avionics, or closely related fields

  • You've architected and shipped a real avionics or embedded system, not just contributed to one

  • Deep fluency in embedded hardware constraints, toolchains, and design tradeoffs

  • Strong instincts around high-assurance systems and what it takes to make them certifiable

  • Clear communicator across disciplines, you can talk to a mechanical engineer and a software architect in the same afternoon and be useful to both

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with a major microcontroller or microprocessor family, not just familiarity

  • Background in robotics, autonomous systems, or aerial platforms

  • Experience with reverse-engineering, network routing, MOSA components, or hardware security modules

  • You've operated in a fast-moving startup environment and know how to make good decisions with incomplete information

As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy work environment, Swarm Aero conducts a thorough screening of prospective employees. Candidates will be subject to a comprehensive background verification process as a prerequisite for employment.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

techaviv-walkme:lever:11757a23-ef3d-45c8.descriptionHtml:

At WalkMe, now an SAP company, we’re not just the leader in digital adoption, we started the digital adoption revolution - enabling organizations to pinpoint and resolve digital friction, regain control of their tech stack, and be better equipped to manage future change. With over 1,600 clients, including 55 Fortune 100 companies and 6 Fortune 10 companies working with us daily, we’re transforming how enterprises interact with their technology.

usv-pluralis-research:ashbyhq:f2e75a40-d.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Distributed ML Systems
usv-pluralis-research:ashbyhq:f2e75a40-d.descriptionHtml:
Overview

Pluralis Research carries out foundational research on Protocol Learning: multi-participant training of foundation models where no single participant has, or can ever obtain, a full copy of the model. The purpose of Protocol Learning is to facilitate the creation of community-trained and community-owned frontier models with self-sustaining economics.

We're looking for Senior/Staff engineers with 5+ years of experience in distributed systems and ML large-scale training. You'll be implementing a novel substrate for training distributed ML models that work under consumer grade internet connection.

Responsibilities

Distributed Training Architecture & Optimization

  • Design and implement large-scale distributed training systems optimized for heterogeneous hardware operating under low-bandwidth, high-latency conditions.

  • Develop and optimize model-parallel training strategies (data, tensor, pipeline parallelism) with custom sharding techniques that minimize communication overhead.

  • Optimize GPU utilization, memory efficiency, and compute performance across distributed nodes.

  • Implement robust checkpointing, state synchronization, and recovery mechanisms for long-running, fault-prone training jobs.

  • Build monitoring and metrics systems to track training progress, model quality, and system bottlenecks.

Decentralized Networking & Resilience

  • Architect resilient training systems where nodes can fail, networks can partition, and participants can dynamically join or leave.

  • Design and optimize peer-to-peer topologies for decentralized coordination across non-co-located nodes.

  • Implement NAT traversal, peer discovery, dynamic routing, and connection lifecycle management.

  • Profile and optimize communication patterns to reduce latency and bandwidth overhead in multi-participant environments.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong experience building and operating distributed systems in production.

  • Hands-on expertise with distributed training frameworks (FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron, or similar).

  • Deep understanding of model parallelism (data, tensor, pipeline parallelism).

  • Expert-level Python with production experience (concurrency, error handling, retry logic, clean architecture).

  • Strong networking fundamentals: P2P systems, gRPC, routing, NAT traversal, distributed coordination.

  • Experience optimizing GPU workloads, memory management, and large-scale compute efficiency.

What We Offer

  • Equity-heavy compensation with meaningful ownership in a mission-driven company

  • Competitive base salary for senior engineering roles in Australia

  • Visa sponsorship available for exceptional candidates

  • Remote-first with optional access to our Melbourne hub

  • World-class team — team mates were previously at at Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and leading startups

Backed by Union Square Ventures and other tier-1 investors, we're a world-class, deeply technical team of ML researchers and engineers. Pluralis is unapologetically ideological. We view the world as a better place if we are able to implement what we are attempting, and Protocol Learning as the only plausible approach to preventing a handful of massive corporations monopolising model development, access and release, and achieving massive economic capture. If this resonates, please apply.

usv-stedi:ashbyhq:6d95b635-f52a-4119-827.title: Product Manager, Eligibility & Insurance Discovery
usv-stedi:ashbyhq:6d95b635-f52a-4119-827.descriptionHtml:
We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse

Stedi is building the first new healthcare clearinghouse in decades. In the healthcare sector, the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) requires that all insurance payers exchange transactions such as claims, eligibility checks, prior authorizations, and remittances using a standardized EDI format called X12 HIPAA. Clearinghouses process the majority of these transactions, offering consolidated connectivity to carriers and providers. Until Stedi, the space was occupied entirely by a small group of legacy players, built on outdated, often pre-internet technology.

Stedi is the world's only programmable healthcare clearinghouse. By offering modern API interfaces alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

We have lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company’s infrastructure; passion for automation and eliminating toil; $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack’s interview with First Round Capital.

What we’re looking for

We are seeking a Product Manager to own one of our products end-to-end. You will shape product requirements, define strategy, drive prioritization, and partner closely with engineering to execute the roadmap.

This role requires someone who can thrive in ambiguity, deeply understand revenue cycle workflows, translate complex payer and customer requirements into actionable product direction, and relentlessly pursue performance, accuracy, and reliability in a real-time transaction environment.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product roadmap for Stedi’s Eligibility or Insurance Discovery offering.

  • Contribute to a team that ships day in and day out – see our blog and changelog

  • Define and drive strategy for real-time eligibility checks, benefit normalization, payer connectivity, and benefit normalization.

  • Report directly to the CEO and work closely with the Head of Engineering to shape product direction.

  • Be the primary author of complex, technical product and business documents (e.g., PR/FAQs, BRDs, Linear tickets).

  • Partner with our design team to develop mockups and wireframes, and our engineering team to prioritize and deliver features.

  • Collaborate with engineering to prioritize and ship features that improve speed, reliability, and data quality.

  • Measure product performance to track adoption and identify areas of investment. Own metrics related to product adoption/engagement.

  • Support and provide expertise on other product initiatives, helping to advance Stedi’s overall product suite.

Who you are

  • Substantial product management experience at a healthcare software company, with a track record of delivering successfully adopted products (B2B products delivered via API are a major plus).

  • 2+ years working in healthcare revenue cycle management, particularly eligibility verification workflows is strongly preferred.

  • Either Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or another technical field, or professional experience writing code are strongly preferred.

  • Have an established, demonstrable track record of driving product adoption and managing a product roadmap.

  • Ability to translate complex customer requirements to a highly technical audience.

  • Highly curious; not satisfied with getting something to work, you want to understand why it works and how to make it high quality.

  • Thrive in an ambiguous environment with a drive to ship early and often.

We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team. Please note:

  • All official communication about roles at Stedi will only come from an @stedi.com email address, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com.

  • If you’re unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to contact us directly at careers@stedi.com.

We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi.

At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.
